Name: Sebastian to Sabrina - Sebastian is a Girl
Author: Paperplane01
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This is a mod for people who want to add a twist to one of the Valley's Character, a literal twist. Experience the Valley with [b]Sabrina[/b], sister of [b]Maru[/b], and one of the daughters of [b]Robin the Carpenter[/b] and [b]Demetrius the Scientist[/b].[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
This mod basically turns [b]Sebastian[/b], one of the Stardew Valley character into a girl named [b]Sabrina[/b].[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Github: [url=https://github.com/Pperplane/Paperplane-Sebastian-is-Girl]https://github.com/Pperplane/Paperplane-Sebastian-is-Girl[/url][/color]

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15713]LadyoftheLight - Sebastian_GIRL Seasonal Outfit and Portrait[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7342]RedK1rby - Beach Outfit and Portrait[/url][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Dialogues Edited By:[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/464]KeionDryke - Sebastian_GIRL Dialogue[/url][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Seasonal Outfit Cycling Inspired By:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Poltergeister - Seasonal Cute Characters[/url][/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][b]Author's Note[/b]
I just compiled 10-year old assets created by these wonderful Artist and Author, all I did is to port it for SMAPI and Content Patcher to be more timely, easy to maintain, and reduce the risk of breaking the game files. Any modification towards the assets, mainly the Arts used and dialogues, you must ask the authors listed to this Mod Page for their permission. Thank you for your understanding!
